front: Least privileged role to create, edit and run notebooks and pipelines
back: Contributor: Write, ReadAll, Execute; cannot add people or share without Reshare. Contributor là role thấp nhất tạo và chạy được item.

ref.label: Roles in workspaces in Microsoft Fabric

front: Workspace role that can read via T-SQL but not via Spark
back: Viewer: has ReadData through the SQL analytics endpoint, no ReadAll. Viewer query được bằng T-SQL nhưng notebook đọc OneLake thì fail.

ref.label: Roles in workspaces in Microsoft Fabric

back: Member adds Member, Contributor, Viewer and shares items; only Admin updates or deletes the workspace, removes users and changes roles. Member không xoá user và không đổi role user đã có.

ref.label: Roles in workspaces in Power BI

back: ReadData = Read all data using SQL (db_datareader). ReadAll = Read all data using Apache Spark and OneLake APIs. Hai permission tách biệt, không cái nào bao cái kia.

ref.label: Share your warehouse and manage permissions

front: Share a warehouse with no additional permissions
back: Recipient gets Read only, equivalent to CONNECT; then GRANT on specific objects. Đây là cách cấp access cho vài table mà không lộ table khác.

ref.label: Share your warehouse and manage permissions

front: Grant access to one lakehouse without access to other items
back: Share the item. Item permission applies only to that item; workspace roles apply to every item. Share không bao giờ cấp Write.

front: Fabric item permission needed before any SQL GRANT works
back: Read on the item (or a workspace role). Without Read the connection fails; CREATE USER is not supported, GRANT creates the user. Có thể GRANT trước rồi cấp Read sau.
GRANT SELECT ON table(col1, col2) TO principal; SELECT * referencing a hidden column fails with Msg 230. CLS trả lỗi, DDM trả giá trị đã mask.

ref.label: Column-level security in Fabric Data Warehouse

back: Inline table-valued function as predicate + CREATE SECURITY POLICY ... ADD FILTER PREDICATE ... WITH (STATE = ON). Policy áp cho mọi user kể cả dbo và Admin.

ref.label: Row-level security in Fabric Data Warehouse

back: DROP SECURITY POLICY, ALTER FUNCTION, re-create the policy; schema-bound functions cannot be altered while bound. Tắt STATE không đủ.

ref.label: Row-level security in Fabric Data Warehouse

back: default(), email(), random(start, end) for numbers, partial(prefix, padding, suffix). Mask áp lên result set, data trong table không đổi.

ref.label: Dynamic data masking in Fabric Data Warehouse

front: Who sees unmasked data in Fabric Warehouse
back: Users with UNMASK or CONTROL; Admin, Member and Contributor have CONTROL. Mask chỉ có tác dụng với Viewer và user được share.

ref.label: Dynamic data masking in Fabric Data Warehouse

back: Viewers and users with item Read permission. Admin, Member, Contributor keep full access through Write, except OneLake RLS on the SQL analytics endpoint in user's identity mode. Thêm Contributor vào role hạn chế không có tác dụng.

ref.label: Table, column, and row-level security in OneLake

back: Default OneLake security role giving every user with ReadAll access to the whole lakehouse. Remove users from it before adding them to a restricted role. Quên bước này thì user vẫn thấy hết.

ref.label: Create and manage OneLake security roles

back: Within a role: OLS ∩ RLS ∩ CLS. Across roles: union, RLS predicates combined with OR. RLS và CLS cho cùng table phải đặt trong một role.

ref.label: How OneLake security controls data access

back: Delegated (default): T-SQL security, owner identity. User's identity: OneLake security roles, user identity. Đổi mode cancel mọi query của SQL endpoint trong workspace.

ref.label: OneLake security for SQL analytics endpoints

back: A label with Control access tied to a Purview protection policy: listed users keep permissions, everyone else is blocked. Label không có policy chỉ là phân loại.

front: Promoted vs Certified vs Master data
back: Promoted: anyone with write. Certified: reviewers named by the Fabric admin. Master data: authorized users, data items only. Endorsement không thay đổi ai đọc được item.
